body:
With NX8's 8-bit static formats, the tensor that loses most even in its best format is layernorm output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256: 32.1 dB SQNR (signal-to-quantization-noise ratio; higher is better) in fp8_e2m5, measured on that tensor alone by the format search. Measured on 9 models with a format search (of 297 surveyed).

Model outputs keep a median 25.6 dB SQNR against full precision, the worst 12.7 dB (stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae). 6 of 8 models with a prediction metric (top-1, perplexity or agreement) lose some of it; the most: facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (token agreement 100% → 64%: the share of token positions whose predicted token matches full precision's), stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (token agreement 100% → 68%: the share of token positions whose predicted token matches full precision's) and PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (agreement 100% → 78%: the share of samples whose predicted class matches full precision's).

The tensors that lose most in their best format (their own error): layernorm output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 32.1 dB), add output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 34.0 dB), embedding output in BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (fp8_e2m5, 34.1 dB), layernorm bias in jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-japanese (fp8_e3m4, 34.2 dB), mul output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 34.5 dB), layernorm bias in openai-community/gpt2 (fp8_e3m4, 34.5 dB), linear bias in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (fp8_e2m5, 34.7 dB), linear output in BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (fp8_e3m4, 34.8 dB), embedding weight in BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (fp8_e3m4, 35.2 dB) and layernorm output in jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-japanese (fp8_e3m4, 35.5 dB).

Separately, the error accumulated along the data path (every tensor before a node quantized too): reciprocal outputs end furthest from full precision, PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 keeping only -inf dB there. The outputs furthest from full precision in each model's best format set: reciprocal in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), mul in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), div in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), log in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), select_where in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -750.7 dB), mul in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, -0.8 dB), aten in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, 0.0 dB, with full precision's selection forced), concat in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, 0.0 dB, with full precision's selection forced), softmax in jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-japanese (fp8_e1m6, 1.9 dB) and bmm in jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-japanese (fp8_e2m5, 4.0 dB).

Formats chosen (E = exponent bits, M = mantissa bits, u = unsigned): fp8_e2m5 4269 (60%), fp8_e3m4 1883 (26%), fp8_e1m6 1001 (14%); 0% of tensors use an unsigned format.

A wider format or a per-row choice would recover most where a tensor's own error in its format, times its data, is largest: silu output in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e2m5, 42.4 dB), conv2d weight in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e2m5, 42.7 dB) and conv2d bias in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e2m5, 43.2 dB).

body:
4 missing capabilities keep 58 operations in 3 models (of 9 planned) off the chip's direct path; the most widespread is run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip) (33 operations in 3 models). In two sections, each ranked by the MACs its gaps hold:

### Substitute proposed or evaluated (1 gap)

**Run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip).** The chip cannot read memory at an address computed at run time, so every lookup or choice by a run-time value (embedding and gather) needs a workaround. It affects 33 operations in 3 models: 33 calls (0.82% of all calls) and no MACs (data movement only); the biggest: embedding in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256, gather in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 and embedding in BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5. Cost today: 0 of 33 have a workaround (0 exact, 0 approximate), 1 failed and 32 wait for one; 11 workarounds proposed, 6 passing its check, 4 evaluated on a model; accuracy not measured yet; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

### Found by the plan, not yet tried (3 gaps)

**An aten::grid_sampler instruction.** The chip has no instruction for aten::grid_sampler, so every aten::grid_sampler needs a workaround. It affects 18 operations in 1 model: 18 calls (0.45% of all calls) and MACs not counted (the capture does not size an ATen op); the biggest: aten::grid_sampler in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365. Cost today: 0 of 18 have a workaround (0 exact, 0 approximate), 0 failed and 18 wait for one; 0 workarounds proposed, 0 passing its check, none evaluated on a model; accuracy not measured yet; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

**An aten::concat instruction.** The chip has no instruction for aten::concat, so every aten::concat needs a workaround. It affects 4 operations in 1 model: 4 calls (0.10% of all calls) and MACs not counted (the capture does not size an ATen op); the biggest: aten::concat in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365. Cost today: 0 of 4 have a workaround (0 exact, 0 approximate), 0 failed and 4 wait for one; 0 workarounds proposed, 0 passing its check, none evaluated on a model; accuracy not measured yet; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

**An integer format for indices.** No NX8 format can hold an integer index computed from the input, so the operations reading one (repeat) need a workaround. It affects 3 operations in 1 model: 3 calls (0.07% of all calls) and no MACs (data movement only); the biggest: repeat in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365. Cost today: 0 of 3 have a workaround (0 exact, 0 approximate), 0 failed and 3 wait for one; 0 workarounds proposed, 0 passing its check, none evaluated on a model; accuracy not measured yet; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

title: Missing instructions: 58 operations in 3 models need workarounds

body:
A kernel reads a tensor in the arrangement its writer stored it in; when the reader needs another arrangement, the reading kernel has to rearrange the data itself. This happens to 608 of 1130 tensors passed between kernels (54%) in 9 models: 414 for attention heads split or merged, 174 for other reshapes, 17 for pixels reordered and 3 for image patches.

The reading operations are 403 operations (403 calls, 10% of all calls; 84.5 G MACs, 3.45% of all MACs). The most common causes (writer → reader): linear → attention (attention heads split or merged) 207, linear → bmm (attention heads split or merged) 201 and linear → add (other reshapes) 58; most in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (196), stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (128) and jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-japanese (88).

Cost today: extra cycles not measured yet (no reading kernel has run); 0 links fail.
title: Layout conversions: 608 of 1130 tensors between kernels are rearranged

body:
Activations with no built-in function at the store (GELU, SiLU, tanh, …) go through a 256-entry lookup table (LUT), which limits their precision: 427 operations in 9 models (427 calls, 11% of all calls), most often silu (234), gelu (73) and gelu_tanh (40). Their quantized accuracy: worst -inf dB SQNR over 384 measured operations.

Kernels per forward pass (host launches, one per planned kernel call): median 13, most 235 (PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365, 235 planned groups), over 9 models.

FP32 headroom (how far the largest value is from FP32 overflow, in powers of ten) is least at 33.4 powers of ten for bmm in jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-japanese (largest value 1.35e+05).

13 outputs in 1 model hold a value at the FP32 limit itself (mostly add (12) and select_where (1), e.g. an attention mask's fill value); they are counted apart from the headroom.

2 accuracy runs produced non-finite outputs (overflow or NaN).

0 kernels use over 80% of the 1,024-word instruction memory (IMEM) bank, of 3 kernels measured.
title: Resource limits: 427 operations limited by the LUT and up to 235 kernel launches per pass

body: Across the surveyed models, the largest measured cost is layout conversion: 525 of 742 inter-kernel tensors (71%) must be rearranged by the reading kernel — mostly for attention head splits/merges (linear→attention, linear→bmm) — affecting 339 calls (11%) holding 83.5 G MACs (3.45%), though cycles are not yet measured. Next, resource limits: 370 operations (13% of calls, mostly SiLU/GELU) must go through a 256-entry LUT with worst-case 10.5 dB SQNR, and kernel launches per pass run to a median of 13 and up to 58. Accuracy cost from NX8 8-bit formats is also significant: model outputs keep a median 26.9 dB SQNR (worst 12.7 dB), 5 of 7 measured models lose prediction metric (worst: DiT-XL-2-256 token agreement 100%→64%), and accumulated path error is worst at mul outputs in DiT-XL-2-256 (−0.8 dB). A smaller cost is the missing run-time addressing instruction, which blocks 30 embedding-lookup calls (1.02% of calls, no MACs) in 2 models with no workaround yet. Compute efficiency (MAC utilisation), cycle counts, and IMEM usage are all not yet measured.
title: Agent summary

body:
**Run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip)** would put 33 operations in 3 models on the chip directly, with no workaround: 33 calls (0.82% of all calls) and no MACs (they only move data); the accuracy it would recover is not measured yet (no workaround evaluated).

**An aten::grid_sampler instruction** would put 18 operations in 1 model on the chip directly, with no workaround: 18 calls (0.45% of all calls) and MACs not counted (the capture does not size an ATen op); the accuracy it would recover is not measured yet (no workaround evaluated).

**An aten::concat instruction** would put 4 operations in 1 model on the chip directly, with no workaround: 4 calls (0.10% of all calls) and MACs not counted (the capture does not size an ATen op); the accuracy it would recover is not measured yet (no workaround evaluated).

**An integer format for indices** would put 3 operations in 1 model on the chip directly, with no workaround: 3 calls (0.07% of all calls) and no MACs (they only move data); the accuracy it would recover is not measured yet (no workaround evaluated).
